turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - nlo_dn_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`, `poscar`
    (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format) and `dn` (the birefringence at
    1064 nm, dimensionless).
  - nlo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose properties are
    NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar` (the crystal
    structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, predict each candidate's birefringence at 1064 nm,
then select the 5 candidates whose birefringence is CLOSEST to 0.1.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, closest first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The birefringence is controlled primarily by crystal anisotropy (cubic/near-cubic cells give \(\mathrm{d}n=0\); strongly layered or chain-like cells give \(\mathrm{d}n\gtrsim0.2\)). Consequently the most reliable predictions are obtained by matching both composition family and lattice metrics to the training examples whose measured \(\mathrm{d}n\) already lie nearest 0.1.

- \(\mathrm{Al_4Hg_2Se_8}\) (c082) is isostructural with \(\mathrm{Ga_4Hg_2Se_8}\) (\(a=5.883\,\text{Å}\), \(c=11.028\,\text{Å}\), \(\mathrm{d}n=0.105\)); the two cells differ by \(<1\,\%\), yielding a predicted value \(0.105\).
- \(\mathrm{In_2Ag_2Ge_2Se_8}\) (c056) matches \(\mathrm{In_2Cu_2Ge_2Se_8}\) (\(a=5.875\,\text{Å}\), \(c=10.881\,\text{Å}\), \(\mathrm{d}n=0.094\)) in the \(ab\) plane and differs only modestly along \(c\), giving \(\approx0.095\).
- \(\mathrm{Li_2MgGa_2Se_5}\) (c098) reproduces the cell of the \(\mathrm{Li_3Mg_2GaSe_5}\) polymorph that has \(\mathrm{d}n=0.118\), hence \(\approx0.11\).
- \(\mathrm{Al_2Cu_2Ge_2Se_8}\) (c071) is the direct Al analogue of \(\mathrm{Ga_2Cu_2Ge_2Se_8}\) (\(\mathrm{d}n=0.123\)) with a cell that differs by \(\sim1\,\%\), hence \(\approx0.12\).
- \(\mathrm{Ca_8Cd_4As_8}\) (c087) is the As analogue of \(\mathrm{Ca_8Cd_4P_8}\) (\(\mathrm{d}n=0.1285\)) with all three axes elongated by only \(3\,\%\), hence \(\approx0.13\).

All other candidates are either cubic (\(\mathrm{d}n=0\)), wurtzite-like polytypes (\(\mathrm{d}n\sim0.01{-}0.02\)), or far more anisotropic (\(\mathrm{d}n>0.2\)). The five listed structures are therefore those whose predicted birefringences lie closest to the target value 0.1 (ranked by increasing \(|\mathrm{d}n-0.1|\)).

Final: c082, c056, c098, c071, c087
